api/SF.Damageable.HealthBase.html.summary: Class HealthBase The base class for holding health data that is used inside of tutorials with data bindings. For an example see the PlayerHUDBars.uxml file to see how a binding is used to change the health bar fill as the CurrentHealth values changes.
